svg.title: Speed lost to load
svg.desc: Line chart of speed lost against distance run at a steady 75 per cent of VO2 reserve, one curve per level. Nothing is lost until load passes each level's onset, after 6.6 km for a beginner, 12.4 recreational, 20.6 trained and 28.9 elite. By 10 km a beginner has lost 2.1 per cent and a recreational runner 0.3. By 21 km: beginner 7.0, recreational 3.0, trained 0.5. By 42 km: 14.8, 9.0, 4.7 and 1.8. By 60 km: 19.8, 13.2, 7.9 and 4.0. By 100 km: 26.8, 19.6, 13.4 and 8.1 per cent. No curve flattens; they bend towards ceilings of 35, 30, 25 and 20 per cent.
